title: Annotatio IV §.XI close: Bede John 6 — eat SPIRITUALLY spiritual food — stop before §.XII
pass_a_gloss: Finally on the sixth chapter of John: Whoever wishes to live, let him believe in Christ, let him eat SPIRITUALLY the SPIRITUAL FOOD, the incorporeal of Christ’s body, and not be a putrid member.
pass_b_english: On John 6: whoever would live, believe in Christ and eat SPIRITUALLY the SPIRITUAL FOOD — the incorporeal of Christ’s body — and not be a putrid member.
source_text: Denique in cap. Joh. sextum: Quisquis vivere vult, credat in Christum, manducet SPIRITUALITER SPIRITUALEM CIBUM incorporeum corporis Christi, & non sit putridum membrum.
